name: ShareX-Uploader
description: Easily upload screenshots and files to a simple CDN using ShareX.

paths.name: FILES_LOCATION
paths.description: Where you want the uploaded files to be stored.

ports.name: Server Port
ports.description: The port to connect to the application on.

variables.name: Max Upload Size
variables.description: The max upload size of files in megabytes. Eg: 500M

variables.name: Upload Secrets
variables.description: You can add multiple secrets. Format: secret1,secret2,secret3

variables.name: Upload Directory
variables.description: The upload directory (If you don't know what this is, ignore it)

variables.name: Use Random File Names
variables.description: Use random file names instead of the original file name. (If this is enabled it will replace the file name given by ShareX with a random one)

variables.name: Random File Name Length
variables.description: The length of the random file name (if above setting is enabled)
